def create_request_frame(address):
    # Check if the address is valid
    if not is_primary_address(address):
        raise ValueError("Invalid address")
    
    # Create the request frame
    frame = bytearray(5)
    frame[0] = 0x10  # Fixed header
    frame[1] = address  # Primary address
    frame[2] = 0x00  # Function code (request)
    frame[3] = 0x00  # Function code (request)
    frame[4] = 0x16  # Checksum
    
    # Calculate the checksum
    checksum = sum(frame[1:4])
    frame[4] = checksum & 0xFF
    
    return bytes(frame)

    frame = create_request_frame(address)
    master.write(frame)

def create_ping_frame(address):
    # Check if the address is valid
    if not is_primary_address(address):
        return b''  # Return an empty bytes object if the address is invalid
    
    # Create the ping frame
    frame = bytearray(5)
    frame[0] = 0x10  # Fixed header
    frame[1] = address  # Primary address
    frame[2] = 0x00  # Function code (ping)
    frame[3] = 0x00  # Function code (ping)
    frame[4] = 0x16  # Checksum
    
    # Calculate the checksum
    checksum = sum(frame[1:4])
    frame[4] = checksum & 0xFF
    
    return bytes(frame)
